title: Ultra Runner Kim Adeyemi on Her First 100 Miler, Blisters and Quitting Twice
creator: Long Way Round Running Pod
description:
Kim Adeyemi went from hating the mile in school to finishing the Western Ridge 100. We talk DNFs, foot care, fueling and the mental game.

Twice?
